# PR #1590: Patch: the tavern's main menu becomes three doors (Play, Collection, Shop)

Closes #1577

## Pull request description (whole branch, passes 1–3)

**What changed and why.** The tavern home's main menu is now exactly three doors — **Play** (yellow, primary, largest, first), **Collection**, **Shop** — leading to the existing `/practice`, `/collection`, and a new `/shop` screen (issue #1577, part of #1576; see the tracker's Goals). Every screen still reachable today is still reachable at its current URL: nothing moved, so no redirect was added (CLAUDE.md rule 13). Account, settings, and legal links live in the account menu and footer. The top screen fits the viewport with no scrolling on desktop and phone; the stats floor below stays where it is. Decisions the spec did not state are recorded as ruling R1577000 (this issue's block): Play opens `/practice` because it is the one play screen needing no account, keeping the door's "No account needed" promise; Shop renders the same panel the account screen shows until the Shop part moves packs out of it.

**Destination map for the later parts (no code):** Play ← practice, play, together, hotseat, match, series, watch, duos; Collection ← decks, creator; Shop ← packs, pack opening, pity, tokens.

**Files.** `apps/web/src/routes/landing.tsx` (three doors, no invite-only note), `landing.css` (three-door grid, short-viewport tightening), `auth/testids.ts` (`landing-play`, `landing-shop`), `net/navigate.ts` (`paths.shop`), `net/head.ts` (`screenNameFor` → "Shop"), `main.tsx` (`/shop` as `Gated` without `EngineGate` — the shop reads only server projections), new `routes/shop.tsx` (same `Shop` panel the account screen shows), both `vercel.json` (rewrites stay byte-identical, `shop` added), ruling `spec/rulings/R1577000.md` + `spec/11-rulings.md` + regenerated `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/09-architecture.md` §9.5 (landing offers no door to Play together), README/test-id cleanups, and updated landing, shell-gate, sign-in, and e2e specs.

**How it was tested.** `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/shop.test.tsx src/routes/gate.test.tsx`: 37 passed. # #1577: Patch: the tavern's main menu becomes three doors (Play, Collection, Shop)
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

Part of #1576 (the tavern menu overhaul). Read the tracker's Goals first.

## What

The tavern home's main menu (the landing page's top screen and the shared nav, `apps/web/src/routes/landing.tsx`, `nav.tsx`) offers exactly three destinations:

1. **Play**: the yellow, primary button, largest and first.
2. **Collection**.
3. **Shop**.

For this part they lead to the existing play, collection and shop screens (later parts reshape those). Every other entry the menu shows today is moved: game destinations under one of the three (note where in the PR, the later parts finish the job), account, settings and legal links to the account menu or the footer. Nothing is lost: every screen still reachable today is still reachable, and every old URL still resolves (redirect where a path moves; CLAUDE.md rule 13).

The account menu keeps account things. Packs, pack opening and pity move out of it in the Shop part, not this one.

## Done when

- The top screen of the landing shows the three doors and nothing competing with them for attention; Play reads as the main action at a glance, on desktop and on a phone.
- The landing's tests (`landing.test.tsx`, `shell-exits.test.tsx` and friends) cover the three doors and where each leads; e2e specs that walk the old menu are updated.
- The top screen fits the viewport with no scrolling on desktop and on a phone (the floor below stays where it is).
- A ruling note in this issue's block if the change decides something the spec does not state.

Do not start the Play, Collection or Shop hubs here.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

| `apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts` | change | Add `shop: "/shop"` to `paths` |
| `apps/web/src/net/head.ts` | change | `screenNameFor`: `case paths.shop: return "Shop"` |
| `apps/web/src/main.tsx` | change | Add `/shop` route: `Gated` (no `EngineGate`; the shop calls no engine) rendering the new `ShopRoute` |

| `apps/web/src/routes/landing-together.test.tsx` | change | Rewrite B54 CTA describes: doors present, no together CTA on landing; keep route-table tests |
| `apps/web/src/routes/sign-in-landing.test.tsx` | change | `playOnline` click → Play door click |
| `e2e/cypress/e2e/14-landing-and-sign-in.cy.ts` | change | B37 block: three doors and their hrefs; corner behavior unchanged |
| `e2e/cypress/e2e/42-together.cy.ts` | change | Landing Play-together click → `visitAs(one, "/together")` |
| `e2e/cypress/e2e/99-online-smoke.cy.ts` | change | `landing-build-decks` click → visit `/decks` directly |
| `e2e/cypress/component/landing-and-code-field.cy.tsx` | change | `LANDING_CTAS` → three doors + sign-in; assert `.landing-hero` bottom is above the fold at all four viewports |
| `spec/rulings/R1577000.md` | new | Ruling: door→destination mapping (Play → `/practice`, Collection → `/collection`, Shop → new `/shop`) |
| `spec/11-rulings.md` | change | One line naming R1577000's source (issue #1577) |
| `spec/INDEX.md` | change | Regenerated by `cargo jackioh spec index` only |

Must not touch: `account.tsx` (packs toggle stays until the Shop part), `nav.tsx` (`BackLink` already returns to `/`), `SiteFooter.tsx` (legal links already there), anything under `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai`, `crates/server`, `apps/web/src/wire/generated`, or `.github/`, `.harness/`, `bot/`. Spec sections governing this change: `spec/14-economy.md` (§14.1, §14.3 shop/packs placement) and `spec/09-architecture.md` (gate behavior); no engine spec section changes.

## Steps

1. In `apps/web/src/auth/testids.ts`, add `play: "landing-play"` and `shop: "landing-shop"` to `landingTestid`, and delete `playAi`, `playOnline`, `buildDecks`, `makeCards` (the together CTA keeps living in `together/testids.ts` but loses its only render site).
2. In `apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts`, add `shop: "/shop"` to `paths`, after the `collection` entry.
3. Create `apps/web/src/routes/shop.tsx`: `ShopRoute({ token }: { token: string })` that lazy-loads `../shop/Shop.tsx` (copy the `lazy` + `Suspense` pattern from `account.tsx`'s `PackOpening` import) and renders it inside the same `app-shell tavern` shell with a `BackLink`; no `EngineGate` wrapper since the shop performs only API reads.
4. In `apps/web/src/main.tsx`, add the `/shop` route next to `/collection`: `Gated` with `key={path}`, passing `account.token` to `ShopRoute`.
5. In `apps/web/src/net/head.ts`, add `case paths.shop: return "Shop";` after the `collection` case, so the tab title and canonical link resolve.
6. In both `vercel.json` and `apps/web/vercel.json`, extend the first rewrite source alternation with `shop` (keeping the two files byte-identical), so `deploy-routes.test.ts` passes for the new path.
7. In `apps/web/src/routes/landing.tsx`, rewrite `Actions()`: a `nav` with `aria-label` carrying three `landing-cta` links — Play (`landing-cta--primary`, `landingTestid.play`, `paths.practice`), Collection (`landingTestid.collection`, `paths.collection`), Shop (`landingTestid.shop`, `paths.shop`) — each a real `<a href>` using `followInApp`, preserving the plain-left-click-navigates / modified-click-left-to-browser behavior the current tests assert. Keep the "No account needed" note under Play; delete the four removed CTAs and the invite-only note (that sentence already lives on `/invite` and `/play`).
8. In `apps/web/src/routes/landing.css`, restyle `.landing-ctas` for three doors (Play full-width primary on top, Collection and Shop side by side below), and constrain the hero so title + fan + doors fit `100dvh` without scrolling at 1280×720 and 390×844: shrink `--fan-card-w`, tighten `.landing-hero-inner` gaps and `.landing-ctas` padding at short heights, extending the existing landscape-phone pattern; leave `PlayerStatsCard` ("the floor") below the fold untouched.
9. Write `spec/rulings/R1577000.md` (front matter `id: R1577000`, title, `cards: "§14.1, §14.3, #1577"`, `proven_in: apps/web/src/routes/landing.test.tsx`), ruling that the Play door leads to `/practice` (the one play screen needing no account), Collection to `/collection`, and Shop to a new `/shop` rendering the existing shop panel while packs stay in the account menu until the Shop part; add the source line in `spec/11-rulings.md`; run `cargo jackioh spec index`.
10. Update all tests listed in **Tests** below, then run the commands there plus `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/deploy-routes.test.ts`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, and `cargo fmt --check`.
11. Write the PR description's destination map for the later parts (no code): Play ← practice, play, together, hotseat, match, series, watch, duos; Collection ← decks, creator; Shop ← packs, pack opening, pity, tokens. No old URL moves, so no redirects are added.

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/routes/landing.test.tsx`: replace `CTAS` with the three doors (`landing-play` → `/practice`, `landing-collection` → `/collection`, `landing-shop` → `/shop`); keep the real-link, in-place-navigation, and modified-click suites; add `it("R1577000 the Play door leads to practice, which needs no account", …)` asserting href plus the "No account needed" note, and `it("R1577000 the removed entries have no call to action on the landing", …)` asserting no links to `/play`, `/together`, `/decks`, `/creator`. Command: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/landing.test.tsx`.
- `apps/web/src/routes/landing-together.test.tsx`: delete the B54 CTA cases that render a together CTA; add `it("B54 the landing offers no Play together call to action", …)` and keep the route-table describes. Command: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/landing-together.test.tsx`.
- `apps/web/src/routes/sign-in-landing.test.tsx`: replace the `playOnline` click with the Play door (`landing-play`) in the pending-account case. Command: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/sign-in-landing.test.tsx`.
- `e2e/cypress/e2e/14-landing-and-sign-in.cy.ts` B37 block: assert the three doors' hrefs (`/practice`, `/collection`, `/shop`) and that sign-in corner behavior is unchanged.
- `e2e/cypress/e2e/42-together.cy.ts`: replace the landing Play-together click with a direct visit to `/together`; keep all gate/friend assertions.
- `e2e/cypress/e2e/99-online-smoke.cy.ts`: replace the `landing-build-decks` click with a direct visit to `/decks`; keep the deck-list assertion.
- `e2e/cypress/component/landing-and-code-field.cy.tsx`: update `LANDING_CTAS` to the three doors plus sign-in, and add an above-the-fold assertion (`.landing-hero` bounding-box bottom ≤ viewport height) at all four viewports, proving the no-scroll requirement.

## Done when

- [ ] Landing top screen shows exactly Play, Collection, Shop; Play is yellow, primary, largest, first, on desktop and a phone.
- [ ] Each door is a real link to its existing screen (`/practice`, `/collection`, `/shop`) and navigates in place on plain left click.
- [ ] Every screen reachable today is still reachable; every old URL still resolves (no path moved, none added except `/shop`).
- [ ] `landing.test.tsx`, `landing-together.test.tsx`, `sign-in-landing.test.tsx`, and `deploy-routes.test.ts` pass; e2e specs 14, 42, 99 and the component layout spec are updated.
- [ ] Hero fits the viewport with no scrolling at 1280×720 and 390×844; the stats floor below is unchanged.
- [ ] R1577000 note exists, `proven_in` lists `landing.test.tsx`, `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] PR description records the game-destination map for the later Play/Collection/Shop parts.

## Risks

- **Shop duplication:** `/shop` and the account packs toggle render the same `Shop` component until the Shop part removes it from the account menu; both read server state per mount, so no divergence, and the duplication is called out in the PR for the Shop part to remove.
- **Play door choice:** pointing Play at `/practice` rather than the gated `/play` lobby keeps anonymous play working and preserves the "No account needed" promise; anyone expecting the lobby still reaches it at `/play`.
- **Renamed testids:** deleting four `landingTestid` entries touches unit and Cypress specs; the steps name every file, and `testids.ts` is plain data so the Cypress bundle is unaffected.
- **Viewport fit by CSS:** exact clamps may need one round of tuning against the component spec's new above-the-fold assertion; the assertion (not eyeballing) is the gate.
- **Client never enforces rules (rule 7):** doors are plain links to gated routes; the gate still decides access, including the pending-account bounce to `/invite`.

## Open questions

None. The one judgment call the tracker leaves open — which existing screen each door leads to — is settled above and recorded as R1577000: Play → `/practice`, Collection → `/collection`, Shop → new `/shop` rendering the existing shop panel.
